comparison.objective: Wrap and finish PTFE tape on a pipe thread; candidate commissions a shock absorber through iterative dynamic tuning.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous dispenser orbit, tension control, tearing and tail pressing versus hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, counterholding and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Tape direction, 3–6 turns, coverage and tail finish versus two impact cycles within stroke, rebound, overload and lock-drift limits.
comparison.reason: No shared tested mechanism beyond generic bimanual tool handling. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, drift-tolerance and tightening-torque thresholds, but those omissions do not suggest this tape task.
